description: Dept. of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on B'Onion w.e.f. 03.10.2019
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing a levy on specific commodities (B' Onions). It involves the exercise of statutory powers to create regulatory measures and rescinds a previous order. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and implementation of existing legislation rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
